2113167718476333567.name: Global Governance Initiative
2113167718476333567.desc: Reposts and versions of foreign ministry material on the Global Governance Initiative (GGI), centred on Wang Yi's 23 October keynote at the 2026 Global Governance Forum in Xiong'an and the follow-up actions he announced.
2113167718476333567.line: China says the world's governance system is unfair and offers its own initiative to reform it.
2113167718476333567.says: PRC accounts present Xi Jinping's Global Governance Initiative as a plan for a "more just and equitable" world order. Around the 23 October forum in Xiong'an they relayed Xi's claim that deficits in peace, development, security and governance are growing, and Wang Yi's eight "practical actions" China says it will take. Foreign voices are quoted praising the initiative.

2113425736040349892.name: 'One Globe, One Community' video
2113425736040349892.desc: A short video on Xi Jinping's idea of a 'community with a shared future for humanity', reposted by embassies and consulates from 23 October.
2113425736040349892.line: A Foreign Ministry video selling Xi's "community with a shared future for humanity".
2113425736040349892.says: Missions reposted a Foreign Ministry video titled "One Globe, One Community". It presents Xi's "community with a shared future for humanity" as a path to mutual respect, fairness, dialogue instead of confrontation, and development for all nations.

sample.text: China’s vision of a community with a shared future for humanity offers a clear path forward. Mutual respect, fairness and justice. Dialogue over confrontation. Development for all. One Globe, One Community.

2112191282000924837.name: Long March 90th anniversary
2112191282000924837.desc: Xi Jinping's remarks marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March, shared from 19 October.
2112191282000924837.line: Xi's speech marking 90 years since the Red Army's Long March, framed as a lesson for today.
2112191282000924837.says: PRC accounts relayed Xi Jinping's 22 October speech commemorating the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March. The framing ties the Communist Party's history to present goals, quoting Xi's call for "new achievements on the new Long March" and his line that only by remembering history can China create a brighter future.

2112207369706835997.name: China–Africa summitry
2112207369706835997.desc: Xi Jinping's four principles on African 'hotspot issues', his four-point proposal on mining cooperation, and readouts of his talks with the leaders of Botswana and Togo.
2112207369706835997.line: Xi's mid-October meetings with African leaders, pitched as China offering principles for Africa's problems.
2112207369706835997.says: Embassies in Africa amplified Xi Jinping's 13 October meetings with the leaders of Togo and Botswana. They highlighted Xi's "four principles" for outside involvement in African conflicts and a four-point proposal on China–Africa mining cooperation, presenting China as a constructive partner.

sample.text: President Xi Jinping put forward four principles for the constructive participation of relevant parties in addressing African hotspot issues.

2114203099862909073.name: Taiwan and the UN seat (25 Oct)
2114203099862909073.desc: Posts on 25 October marking 'Taiwan Retrocession Day' with a video titled 'The Way Home', and the 55th anniversary of UN General Assembly Resolution 2758.
2114203099862909073.line: 25 October anniversaries used to assert that Taiwan belongs to China and the PRC alone represents China at the UN.
2114203099862909073.says: On 25 October PRC accounts marked two anniversaries together: Taiwan's 1945 handover from Japanese rule, which they call "Taiwan's Restoration", and UN Resolution 2758 of 1971, which seated the PRC at the UN. The framing claims both events settle Taiwan's status as part of China, and praises China's 55 years at the UN.

sample.text: This 25 October marks 55 years since the restoration of China's lawful seat at the United Nations. Over these 55 years, China has upheld the central role of the United Nations and has worked tirelessly for a fairer and more…

2112864846152622086.desc: Promotion of the APEC meetings China hosts in November, including the Shenzhen leaders' week and the finance ministers' meeting in Hong Kong.
2112864846152622086.line: Promotion of Shenzhen as host of APEC 2026.
2112864846152622086.says: PRC accounts promoted Shenzhen's preparations to host the APEC leaders' meeting in November 2026, along with related APEC ministerial meetings.

2112455439241888008.desc: Readouts of Premier Li Qiang's meetings on the sidelines of the SCO prime ministers' council in Dushanbe.
2112455439241888008.line: Premier Li Qiang at the SCO prime ministers' meeting in Tajikistan.
2112455439241888008.says: PRC accounts covered Premier Li Qiang's meetings at the 25th SCO heads-of-government council in Dushanbe, including with Iran's first vice president, stressing respect for sovereignty and security.

2112348074622497110.name: Autumn in China (tourism)
2112348074622497110.desc: A tourism post and photos of autumn scenery in China, shared from 20 October.
2112348074622497110.line: Tourism images of China in autumn.
2112348074622497110.says: Missions posted travel imagery of autumn scenery in China to promote the country as a destination.

2113214937451676009.name: China Railway Express milestone
2113214937451676009.desc: Promotion of the China–Europe freight train service passing 140,000 trips across Eurasia, shared from 22 October.
2113214937451676009.line: China Railway Express passing 140,000 Europe–Asia freight trips.
2113214937451676009.says: Spokesperson Mao Ning and missions celebrated more than 140,000 China Railway Express freight trips across Eurasia, framed as more trade and shared prosperity.

2115036845063184458.name: Xi congratulates Lula on re-election
2115036845063184458.desc: Posts, reposts and quotes of the foreign ministry spokesperson's 27 October post on Xi Jinping's congratulatory message to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on his re-election as President of Brazil, carried mainly by PRC accounts in Brazil and Latin America.
2115036845063184458.line: China welcomes Lula's re-election and pledges closer China–Brazil ties.
2115036845063184458.says: PRC accounts relay Xi Jinping's message congratulating Lula on his re-election as Brazil's president. Xi praises Lula's contributions to China–Brazil relations and says he will work with him to deepen the partnership. The post spread in Portuguese, Spanish and English from the foreign ministry to the embassy and consulates in Brazil and to other posts in Latin America and India.

sample.text: President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on his re-election as President of the Federative Republic of Brazil. President Xi applauded President Lula’s contributions to China–Brazil relations and pledged to work with…

2113112293596877103.name: CPC fifth plenary session (20th Central Committee)
2113112293596877103.desc: Posts, reposts and quotes about the fifth plenary session of the 20th Communist Party of China Central Committee, from explainers on why it matters (from 22 October) to reports that the session opened on 27 October and that it closed on 29 October with a resolution on full and rigorous Party self-governance.
2113112293596877103.line: China presents the Party's fifth plenum as a key meeting setting the country's direction.
2113112293596877103.says: PRC embassies and consulates share explainers on why the fifth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee matters, then relay news that the session has started. The foreign ministry and posts in Africa, Asia, Europe, the Americas and the Pacific carry the same material in English.

sample.text: Why China's upcoming 5th plenum of 20th CPC Central Committee matters

2114724249894355429.name: China's AI capacity-building progress report
2114724249894355429.desc: Posts and reposts about the Progress Report on the AI Capacity-Building Action Plan for Good and for All, which China released at the 2026 Global Governance Forum in Xiong'an, including spokesperson Guo Jiakun's 26 October press-conference answer on it.
2114724249894355429.line: China presents its AI capacity-building report as help for developing countries to access and build AI.
2114724249894355429.says: PRC embassies and consulates relay that Foreign Minister Wang Yi announced, and China then released, a progress report on its AI Capacity-Building Action Plan at the 2026 Global Governance Forum in Xiong'an. The posts say the report treats access to technology as the starting point and independent development as the goal, and quote spokesperson Guo Jiakun on AI capacity-building in global governance.

2115793515594854423.name: Fifth plenum resolution on Party self-governance
2115793515594854423.desc: Posts, reposts and quotes of spokesperson Mao Ning's 29 October post that the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee adopted a resolution on full and rigorous Party self-governance, with a link to the session communiqué in Chinese and English.
2115793515594854423.line: China announces the fifth plenum's resolution on full and rigorous Party self-governance.
2115793515594854423.says: PRC accounts relay that the fifth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee adopted a resolution on persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance, and link to the full communiqué. The post spread within hours from the foreign ministry to missions in the Americas, Europe, Africa, the Middle East and Asia.

2113537497439617435.name: German President Steinmeier's state visit to China
2113537497439617435.desc: Posts and reposts about German Federal President Frank-Walter Steinmeier's 27–31 October state visit to China, from the 23 October announcement through his stops in Hefei and Huangshan to Xi Jinping's welcome ceremony and talks with him in Beijing on 30 October.
2113537497439617435.line: China presents Steinmeier's visit as a sign of deeper China–Germany cooperation.
2113537497439617435.says: PRC accounts announce the visit, follow Steinmeier to Volkswagen's Hefei technology centre and Mount Huangshan, then relay Xi Jinping's welcome ceremony and talks, in which Xi calls for closer China–Germany communication and coordination. Missions in Germany, Europe and Asia carry the posts in English and German.

2109667429089468533.name: 140th Canton Fair
2109667429089468533.desc: Posts, reposts and quotes of Xi Jinping's October 14 congratulatory letter to the 140th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair) in Guangzhou and of the fair's trade highlights, carried by embassies, consulates and spokespeople from mid-October into November.
2109667429089468533.line: China uses the Canton Fair to present itself as a defender of open, multilateral trade.
2109667429089468533.says: PRC accounts relay Xi Jinping's letter to the 140th Canton Fair, in which he says China is willing to join hands with countries around the world to safeguard the multilateral trading system. Later posts promote the fair's smart-manufacturing exhibits. The message spread from embassies in Germany, Eritrea, the United States and the EU mission to posts across Europe, Africa and Asia.

2109503228446667065.name: 140th Canton Fair
2109503228446667065.desc: Posts, reposts and quotes of Premier Li Qiang's keynote speech at the opening of the 140th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair) in Guangzhou, October 2026.
2109503228446667065.line: China uses the Canton Fair to present itself as a defender of open, multilateral trade.
2109503228446667065.says: PRC accounts relay Premier Li Qiang's opening speech at the 140th Canton Fair, where he pledges to keep integrating China's domestic market with the world and to promote common growth. The post spread from the embassy in the Maldives to posts in Kenya, Sri Lanka, the EU, the United Kingdom and ASEAN.

2117213838546489364.name: China International Import Expo countdown
2117213838546489364.desc: Posts, reposts and quotes of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' countdown to the ninth China International Import Expo (CIIE) in Shanghai, with #CIIE2026.
2117213838546489364.line: China promotes its import expo as a showcase of an open market.
2117213838546489364.says: PRC accounts relay the foreign ministry's "3 days countdown" to the ninth China International Import Expo. The post spread from the ministry in Beijing to missions in the United States, New Zealand, Fiji, the Maldives, the UAE, South Africa and Pakistan over about 27 hours.

sample.text: 3 Days countdown to the ninth China International Import Expo! CIIE CIIE2026

2117125783420637695.name: Xi on a community with a shared future in cyberspace
2117125783420637695.desc: Posts, reposts and quotes of a video clip of Xi Jinping calling for countries to build a community with a shared future in cyberspace.
2117125783420637695.line: China frames its internet governance as a shared global good.
2117125783420637695.says: PRC accounts relay a video of Xi Jinping urging countries to "work together to build a community with a shared future in cyberspace" so the internet benefits people everywhere. The clip started at the embassy in the Maldives and spread to missions in Ghana, the UAE, the United Kingdom, Grenada, Canada, South Sudan, South Africa, Bahrain and Ireland over about 28 hours.

sample.text: President Xi Jinping has called on countries around the world to work together to build a community with a shared future in cyberspace, making the internet a greater benefit to people around the world. Click the video to hear what he has said.

2118173471310262603.name: Ninth China International Import Expo opening
2118173471310262603.desc: Posts, reposts and quotes announcing that the ninth China International Import Expo opened in Shanghai on November 5, 2026. One wording is the foreign ministry's "Ever Fresh at Nine" message. The other, from spokesperson Mao Ning, says the expo opened with a record 4,100-plus overseas exhibitors from 162 countries, regions and international organizations.
2118173471310262603.line: China announces that the ninth import expo is open in Shanghai.
2118173471310262603.says: PRC accounts posted two opening messages. The foreign ministry's "Ever Fresh at Nine" line says nine editions of the China International Import Expo have brought opportunities for cooperation. Spokesperson Mao Ning's line says the expo opened in Shanghai with a record 4,100-plus overseas exhibitors from 162 countries, regions and international organizations, and that China's door is opening wider. The posts spread from the ministry and the spokespersons to embassies and consulates in North America, Europe, Africa, the Middle East and Asia from November 5 to November 8.

sample.text: Ever Fresh at Nine — the ninth China International Import Expo is officially open! Nine editions on, the CIIE keeps bringing fresh opportunities for global winwin cooperation.

2118197772671483965.name: Japan constitution anniversary rally
2118197772671483965.desc: Chinese and Japanese posts from the embassy and consulates in Japan saying that about 14,000 people rallied in Tokyo on November 3, the 80th anniversary of the current constitution, calling to defend the peace constitution and oppose military expansion and constitutional revision.
2118197772671483965.line: PRC posts in Japan describe a Tokyo rally on the constitution's 80th anniversary.
2118197772671483965.says: On November 5 the embassy in Japan posted, in Chinese and then Japanese, that about 14,000 people rallied in Tokyo on November 3, held signs calling to oppose war, and urged protection of the peace constitution and opposition to military expansion and constitutional revision. The consulates in Nagasaki, Osaka and Nagoya reposted it within about two and a half hours. The crowd figure and the description of the rally are the accounts' own statements.

sample.text: 11月3日，日本现行宪法公布80周年纪念日当天，约1.4万名民众在东京举行集会，高举“反对战争”“宪法是和平之基”等标语，呼吁守护和平宪法，反对扩军修宪。

2117926689594548572.name: Wang Yi at the 37th APEC ministerial meeting
2117926689594548572.desc: Posts, reposts and one quote of spokesperson Lin Jian's November 4 readout of Wang Yi's video remarks to the 37th APEC Ministerial Meeting.
2117926689594548572.line: Wang Yi's video remarks to the 37th APEC ministerial meeting, as posted by the foreign ministry.
2117926689594548572.says: Spokesperson Lin Jian posted what he said were Wang Yi's remarks to the 37th APEC Ministerial Meeting, held by video. The post says China is hosting APEC for the first time in 12 years and has held more than 300 meetings during the APEC "China Year." The foreign ministry, the consulate in Dubai, the embassy in Switzerland and the mission in Vienna carried that text on November 4 and 5. The mission to the African Union quoted the same post.
